titulo: Unpacking the bag today, not next week
caption:
Unpacking the bag today, not next week

A bag left packed for a week becomes the bag you live out of. Three things, one drawer, now.

Unpacking is fifteen minutes today and a week of digging tomorrow.

For whoever unpacks the bag the day it comes home.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A bedroom with a blue bag on the floor at the right with three small things on top, and a dresser drawer above it. A plum block figure with narrowed eyes stands at the left and an ink-black one with white eyes next to it. A bubble says tomorrow. it's just a bag. The black one answers now, and the three things fly into the open drawer one by one. The plum one's eyes go wide. Both end with happy eyes. The text stays: me unpacking the same day.
